verdict.rationale: Cactus is an LLM inference engine, so inference-serving performance is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence describes separating prefill and decode phases or large-scale serving. The evidence instead stresses on-device execution with "no GPU, no server," plus local-to-cloud routing by model confidence. Neither of those is prefill/decode disaggregation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
